name: UMMC
note: Club sponsor of HC Avtomobilist per the club's sponsors page (archived capture of 8 July 2025; the page footer calls ОАО «УГМК» the club's general sponsor). UMMC also holds arena naming rights (УГМК Арена). Founded and owned by Iskander Makhmudov per US Treasury (September 2023); US/UK/NZ sanctions are not human-rights findings under the method. Left UNRATED on the company test: the Business & Human Rights Resource Centre (citing Rostekhnadzor, 8 December 2025, https://www.business-humanrights.org/en/latest-news/russia-worker-injured-at-nadezhdinsky-metallurgical-plant-due-to-industrial-safety-violations/) records a worker injured at PJSC Nadezhdinsky Metallurgical Plant (a UMMC company) caused by violations of industrial safety regulations, with administrative proceedings initiated; and (citing Interfax, 11 August 2021, https://www.business-humanrights.org/en/latest-news/russia-worker-killed-in-accident-at-korbalikhinsky-mine-criminal-case-initiated/) a worker killed in an accident at the Korbalikhinsky mine (JSC Siberia-Polymetals, a UMMC company), with a criminal case initiated over safety violations. A maintainer should judge whether these pass METHOD.md's company test.
